compiled_state.title: Implement: add 'Premise to confirm' branch to SC Gap Check in post-scrutiny-handlers.md (8c28-9f34)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## testing_mode: GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: SC Gap Check section contains a 'Premise to confirm' branch for assumption findings without user-outcome SC mapping, with confirm/revise/accept-risk options (makes RED test GREEN)
- DD4: A synthetic NFR-style assumption finding without user-outcome SC mapping surfaces under the 'Premise to confirm' line at SC Gap Check prompt with all three response options

## What to Do
Modify `plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/post-scrutiny-handlers.md`, in the `## SC Gap Check` section.

After step 3 ("If gaps found ... present the proposed SC revisions..."), add a new step 3.5:

"3.5. **Assumption findings without user-outcome SC mapping** (Premise to confirm): After processing SC coverage gaps, inspect the surviving `## Scenario Analysis` findings for entries with `\"category\": \"assumption\"` that do not map to any user-outcome SC. For each such finding, surface it under a `Premise to confirm` line in the SC Gap Check AskUserQuestion:

> 'The following assumption findings have no corresponding user-outcome SC: [list findings]. For each, do you want to (a) Confirm: accept the premise as valid and continue, (b) Revise: update the spec to add an SC covering this assumption, or (c) Accept risk: document the assumption risk and continue without a new SC?'

No severity filter is applied — all assumption findings regardless of severity (low, medium, high, critical) surface under this branch. The schema enum value that identifies these findings is `\"assumption\"` (the literal string emitted by S3 scenario-red-team.md)."

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `post-scrutiny-handlers.md` SC Gap Check section contains "Premise to confirm"
  Verify: grep -q "Premise to confirm" plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/post-scrutiny-handlers.md
- [ ] File contains confirm/revise/accept-risk options
  Verify: grep -qE "confirm|revise|accept.risk" plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/post-scrutiny-handlers.md
- [ ] File contains literal string "assumption" in SC Gap Check context
  Verify: grep -q '"assumption"' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/post-scrutiny-handlers.md
- [ ] No severity filter in the assumption branch
  Verify: grep -A5 "Premise to confirm" plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/post-scrutiny-handlers.md | grep -qvE "severity.*(critical|high)|filter.*severity"
- [ ] RED tests now pass GREEN
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-brainstorm-sc-gap-assumption.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
